grants.description: THE EXXON MOBIL BAYTOWN OLEFINS PLANT CARBON REDUCTION PROJECT SEEKS TO ENABLE THE USE OF HYDROGEN IN PLACE OF NATURAL GAS ACROSS HIGH HEAT-FIRED EQUIPMENT FOR CHEMICAL AND FUEL PRODUCTION AT THE BAYTOWN OLEFINS PLANT (BOP), CHEMICAL PLANT, AND REFINERY. THIS PROJECT AIMS TO BE THE FIRST LARGE-SCALE
